nodes.notes: Runs daily at 09:00 UTC — after Today's_notifs (08:45) and Reminders (08:30)

parameters.query:
SELECT vn.*
FROM vehicle_notifications vn
  JOIN organizations o ON vn.organization_id = o.id
  JOIN tiers t ON o.tier_id = t.id
WHERE
  vn.is_aggressive_mode = true
  AND vn.status = 'no_response'
  AND vn."confirmedAt" IS NULL
  AND vn.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND t.name = 'BUSINESS'
  AND (o.free_trial_end_date IS NULL OR o.free_trial_end_date > NOW())
  AND (
    vn."duty_batch_id" IS NULL
    OR vn.id = (
      SELECT sub.id FROM vehicle_notifications sub
      WHERE sub."duty_batch_id" = vn."duty_batch_id"
        AND sub.is_pdr = false
        AND sub.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY sub."notificationDate" DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  )
  AND (
    vn.aggressive_start IS NULL
    OR (NOW() BETWEEN vn.aggressive_start AND vn.aggressive_end)
  );

parameters.query:
UPDATE vehicle_notifications
SET aggressive_start = CASE WHEN aggressive_start IS NULL THEN '{{ $json._aggressiveStart }}' ELSE aggressive_start END,
    aggressive_end = CASE WHEN aggressive_end IS NULL THEN '{{ $json._aggressiveEnd }}' ELSE aggressive_end END,
    confirmation_token = CASE WHEN '{{ $json._needsNewToken }}' = 'true' THEN '{{ $json._newToken }}' ELSE confirmation_token END,
    token_expires_at = CASE WHEN '{{ $json._needsNewToken }}' = 'true' THEN (NOW() + INTERVAL '3 days') ELSE token_expires_at END
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
RETURNING *;

  "personName",

  "dutyDate",

  status,

  my_vehicle_id,

  true,
  '{{ $json.duty_batch_id }}',
  false,
  '{{ $json.organization_id }}',
  '{{ $json.vehicleRegistration }}',
  '{{ $json.notificationType }}',
  '{{ $json.notificationChannel }}',
  '{{ $json.personName }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',

  'imported',
  {{ $json.user_id ? "'" + $json.user_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.my_vehicle_id ? "'" + $json.my_vehicle_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
